{{Quote|My parents gave it to me when I left to take on the Governorship of Theed. It's a stone my father found on our land. My mother fashioned the clasp. The amulet means everything to me.|Padmé Amidala|<ref name="SWEIJQA" />}}
An '''amulet''' made of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] and [[Stone/Legends|stone]] was created by the [[Parent/Legends|parents]] [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee]] and [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal Naberrie]]. It was given to their [[Reproduction/Legends|daughter]] and [[Princess of Theed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].

==Description==
The amulet was made of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] and [[Stone/Legends|stone]] and strung on a cord.<ref name="TQA" />

==History==
[[File:Amidala_lends_her_amulet_to_Sabe.png|thumb|left|200px|Amidala lends her amulet to her handmaiden, Sabé.]]
The amulet was given to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] by her [[Parent/Legends|parents]] when she became [[Princess of Theed]]. [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee Naberrie]] found the precious stone on their very own land and [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal Naberrie]] crafted the clasp herself. In the young [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] opinion, this single object represented all the love and protection her parents endowed to her.<ref name="SWEIJQA" /> 

One [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Amidala woke up from a bad [[Dream/Legends|dream]] about [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire and her amulet falling and realized that the amulet was missing from its cord. One of her [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaidens]], [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], entered her room and asked what was wrong. Amidala suspected she had lost the amulet the prior day while in a meadow. Before the others woke up, Sabé and Amidala left [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] for the countryside to search for the item. When its polished metal sparkled in the grass beneath a tall tree, Sabé located it.<ref name="TQA" />

Upon returning to [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] and rushing to the [[Throne room (Theed Royal Palace)/Legends|throne room]], the Queen learned that the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] had [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockaded]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Amidala and her handmaiden knew what they must do; telling no one else, Sabé dressed as the Queen to serve as her decoy while Amidala dressed in [[Flame-colored robes/Legends|flame-colored robes]] to become Padmé the handmaiden.<ref name="TQA" />

Knowing that the entire planet depended on them and that Sabé was in the most danger while disguised, Amidala gave her amulet to her dear friend to wear as a symbol of her gratitude for Sabé's bravery. Sabé initially refused and said it was her honor to serve, but Amidala fastened it around Sabé's neck and assured her that the Queen would wear it again when Naboo was safe.<ref name="TQA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The amulet first appeared in the [[1999]] young readers book ''[[The Queen's Amulet]]'', written by [[Julianne Balmain]] and illustrated by [[Matilda Harrison]].<ref name="TQA" />
